name: Tenma Akuro
source:
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.

Always acting together with [url=https://vndb.org/c34810]Morei[/url], [spoiler]having a relationship with her as both brother and lover[/spoiler], he also shared a deep hatred towards the people outside Edo just like other members of Yatsukahagi [spoiler]although he is an easygoing person that will create comfortable atmosphere to talk with[/spoiler].

It could be said that he is the most dangerous person among all the Tenmas as well.

"Filfthy outsiders, in this Twilight i will grind all of you into dust and bury deep under the ground."

[spoiler]In truth he is one of the male character in [url=https://vndb.org/v548#main]Dies Irae[/url] as well as brother of [url=https://vndb.org/c28991]Kei Sakurai[/url] and lover of [url=https://vndb.org/c28999]Beatrice Kircheisen[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c34711]Kai Sakurai[/url], after the death of [url=https://vndb.org/c29001]Marie[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28998]Mercurius[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c22061]Reinhard Heydrich[/url], he along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url] in order to protect what's left of her world.[/spoiler]
